schedule.meaning: Per rule and step, the degree to which the rule may carry matched mass in the Chain tab: 1 full forward, .5 partial (each pair at most half of its capacity), -1 / -.5 reverse, 0 off. Derived from each rule's forward and reverse matched capacity at each step on exact spellings after parking the skipped groups (rules_by_step.js), with the mechanical rule of derive_schedule.py (full: >= 50 per 10k, twice the other direction, >= 10 tokens; partial: >= 15 per 10k, at least the other direction, >= 5 tokens; a near-tie under 1.1x is off), the overrides, caps and exclusions listed, and the held-out status of each cell (heldout.js: both halves of the pools, one, neither, opposite). The two-step rules are scheduled as halves; the tab composes two-step routes and A+B labels from their parts (same sign, smaller degree; a parent code inside a composition means its .via row when scheduled, else its halves) and lets labels of equal degree and opposite sign cancel; no_new_d closes every pair that adds a dy ending at the A-side steps. v2.2 adds the five section-connection families of 13 October as rows at their mechanical degrees and the two steps of Golf's fork at 3a (3a>3c, 3b>4a; the fork's shared steps take the chain's cells). Capacities are bounds, never token ancestry; direction along the order is the user's working assumption.

identity.representation: Implicit identity edge i -> i for every word at every stage; not included in step_edges.
identity.warning: Identity weight and row normalization belong to the synthetic channel model, not the empirical schedule.

definitions.universe: All observed exact-q spellings in the nine paragraph stages, including all singleton types. No rare-word floor.
definitions.units: Canonical voynich_toolkit.eva.atom_strings: ch/sh and ckh/cth/cph/cfh atomic; repeated e/i separate. saved_units retain app Zattera runs for sensitivity.
definitions.degree: Current CF.pairDegree: largest absolute supporting label; equal opposing signs cancel; composed labels require same-sign permitted parts and use minimum magnitude.
definitions.direction: Signed schedule cell or composed label, with A-side no-new-dy guard. Catalogue direction sign is retained even after endpoints are reversed.
definitions.probability: Degrees are capacity limits, not frequencies or application probabilities. Any stochastic normalization is an explicit simulation assumption.
definitions.attestation: Nonidentity edges are app globally attested candidates restricted to the complete nine-stage universe, not an open-vocabulary grammar. Rare absence of an edge is not evidence of no historical relationship.
definitions.chronology: User working alternate chain, not established historical chronology. Rule confidence unchanged.
